summary_variants.text: Full-Stack Software Engineer with 2+ years of hands-on experience building performant web applications, distributed edge systems, and responsive frontends. Creator and lead engineer of the EPD community platform (Next.js, Cloudflare Pages & D1 edge SQLite, Telegram Bot integration), serving weekly event operations with sub-50ms latency. Proficient in TypeScript and Python across modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS) and backend services (Django, RESTful APIs). Pursuing a B.S. in Computer Engineering at University of Birjand.

Frontend-focused Full-Stack Engineer with 2+ years building responsive, accessible React and Next.js interfaces. Strong on TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, state management, and Core Web Vitals performance (98+ scores delivered). Comfortable across the stack with Python/Django REST APIs and serverless edge deployment on Cloudflare.

Backend-leaning Full-Stack Engineer with 2+ years building RESTful services and data-driven dashboards. Experienced in Python, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, and SQLite, plus serverless edge data layers (Cloudflare D1, KV). Ships clean, modular code with CI/CD and Git-based workflows.

Full-Stack Engineer specializing in web platforms with deep Telegram Bot automation and payment/webhook integrations. 2+ years delivering production systems on Next.js, Cloudflare Workers/Pages, D1, and Python/Django. Owns features end-to-end, from schema design to bot UX.
